meta.units: D = 8 cm cup diameter; boundary distance in D (x 80 = mm); gap widths in mm
meta.frames: sim c_M compared as c_M[::-1, :] in the target T frame; leaf and swan targets first rotated into the canonical pattern frame by PHI (documented frame correction, not fitted); figures show the physical top view (no mirror), canonical frame (B / pour start at top, cut exit / stem at bottom)
meta.align_best: rotation |theta| <= 25.0 deg (CCW, physical top view) about the cup centre + shift |dx|,|dy| <= 0.06 D (physical x right, y up), maximising IoU(c>0.4) on a 1 deg / 0.01 D grid refined to 0.25 deg / 0.0025 D; the same transform for all other metrics
meta.diagnostic_full_circle: best IoU(c>0.4) over theta in [-180,180) step 5 deg x shifts {-0.06,-0.03,0,0.03,0.06} D, as simulated and mirrored; NOT an alignment used in the tables

sims.PHYS: all-physical strictB3; flow-pulse peak moved from Codex's pi to 0 for tulip / leaf / swan (P4f patch, made after P4 with pi failed) and to pi/2 for layered_heart (strictfp90); both phases are post-hoc action re-guesses

meta.gap_rule: cf_runner.axis_gaps: lines x = 0, -0.05, +0.05 D (T frame), 0.1 mm steps, white runs < 0.5 mm dropped, gap = brown run >= 1 mm strictly between two white runs

summary.verdict: 全物理与 V0.5 离真实视频一样远：PHYS−V0.5 的 IoU 差在 −0.04…+0.11（均值约 +0.01），比两者与真实的差距（IoU 0.29–0.74，真实的细褐线多 2–6 倍）小得多；差距主要是图案大小、细褐线数量和元件布局。这些差距不是入口物理化造成的；它们来自猜的动作还是模型本身（单层闭合、足迹、扩散），这次比较分不开，要用 stage_scripts 里从视频读出的真实动作去跑（任务 #30）才能分开。
